slots.palette: warm tropical palette with deep indigo night accents
slots.setting: a cheerful beach luau with a tiki BBQ for cute animals on a warm evening
slots.decorations: Pale sand, light bamboo, thatched palm-leaf roofs, and a few palm fronds and hibiscus flowers around the edges of the screen.
slots.background_tones: warm (sand, cream, light bamboo, glowing in torchlight)
slots.kitchen: a small tiki grill hut with a thatched palm-leaf roof, a gently smoking BBQ grill and a glowing lantern
slots.loop_interior: a calm dark turquoise lagoon reflecting the moon and the festoon lights, with a floating hibiscus flower and a small floating candle
slots.foods: a grilled pineapple ring, a small skewer, a grilled shrimp, a corn cob or a coconut cup
slots.counter: a light bamboo tiki bar counter with a short thatched fringe along its front edge
slots.accessory: a small flower lei around its neck
slots.board_surface: a pale cream woven palm-leaf mat framed with a thin bamboo border, lit by warm torchlight
slots.obstacles: a coconut, a pineapple and a small ukulele
slots.mood: festive, warm and cozy, a happy evening party with everyone eating
slots.lighting: Warm soft torchlight and festoon glow
slots.night_sky: a deep indigo sky with small twinkling stars and a soft moon glow, only around the outer edges
slots.light_sources: tall tiki torches along the left and right edges, strings of warm festoon bulbs above both belts, two lanterns on the tiki bar and a lantern on the grill hut
slots.effects: three tiki torches on each side at the left and right edges, evenly spaced over the belt and board areas, festoon strings over both belts, a few fireflies near the edges, and moonlight on the water inside the loop
slots.extra_avoid: large flames, smoke covering anything, animals in the water, torches or fireflies over the board
